a: I have some vermouth and bitters. What cocktails can I make with those ingredients?
r: You can add whiskey to your vermouth and bitters to make a manhattan. Alternatively, if you have gin you can mix dry vermouth to make a martini or combine with sweet vermouth and Campari to make a negroni.
